cultural_notes_faq.q: What is an Author's Leave Note?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A *qingjia tiao* is a notice from a web novel author to readers explaining a delay, error, or schedule change; it’s a normal and trusted part of Chinese web serialization culture.
The author, Wang Yu, fell ill with a fever after several late nights and forgot to mention Qu Hun’s status in the previous chapter; he corrected the error and posted this note to inform readers.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Should I re-read the previous chapter?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes, the author has corrected the oversight about Qu Hun, so re-reading it will give you the complete, intended picture.
